Row.SQL: WITH check_mutation_result AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT $1::uuid AS "department_id", $2::text::pg_catalog.uuid AS "file_id") AS data WHERE data."department_id" = ANY($3::uuid[])), check_count AS (SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM check_mutation_result) >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE (SELECT 0 FROM (SELECT constellation_throw_error('check constraint of an insert/update permission has failed', 'ZZ901')) x) END AS status), mutation_result AS (INSERT INTO "public"."department_files" ("department_id", "file_id") SELECT check_mutation_result."department_id", check_mutation_result."file_id" FROM check_mutation_result WHERE (SELECT status FROM check_count) = 1 RETURNING *) SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json("_physical")), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT "id"::text AS "id", "file_id"::text AS "file_id", "department_id"::text AS "department_id", "description"::text AS "description" FROM mutation_result) AS "_physical"

Batch.SQL: WITH check_mutation_result AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT $1::uuid AS "id", $2::text AS "bucket_id", $3::uuid AS "uploaded_by_user_id") AS data WHERE data."bucket_id" = ANY($4::text[])), check_count AS (SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM check_mutation_result) >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE (SELECT 0 FROM (SELECT constellation_throw_error('check constraint of an insert/update permission has failed', 'ZZ901')) x) END AS status), mutation_result AS (INSERT INTO "storage"."files" ("id", "bucket_id", "uploaded_by_user_id") SELECT check_mutation_result."id", check_mutation_result."bucket_id", check_mutation_result."uploaded_by_user_id" FROM check_mutation_result WHERE (SELECT status FROM check_count) = 1 RETURNING *) SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json("_physical")), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT "id"::text AS "id", "created_at"::text AS "created_at", "updated_at"::text AS "updated_at", "bucket_id"::text AS "bucket_id", "name"::text AS "name", "size"::text AS "size", "mime_type"::text AS "mime_type", "etag"::text AS "etag", "is_uploaded"::text AS "is_uploaded", "uploaded_by_user_id"::text AS "uploaded_by_user_id", "metadata"::text AS "metadata" FROM mutation_result) AS "_physical"

Insert.FinalSQL: WITH mutation_result AS (SELECT (value ->> 'id')::text::pg_catalog.uuid AS "id", (value ->> 'file_id')::text::pg_catalog.uuid AS "file_id", (value ->> 'department_id')::text::pg_catalog.uuid AS "department_id", (value ->> 'description')::text::pg_catalog.text AS "description" FROM json_array_elements($1::json) AS "_rows"(value)) SELECT row_to_json((SELECT "_e" FROM (SELECT "mutation_result.r.file"."file" AS "file", "mutation_result.r.department"."department" AS "department") AS "_e")) FROM mutation_result LEFT OUTER JOIN LATERAL (WITH "mutation_result.r.file.base" AS (SELECT * FROM "storage"."files" WHERE "mutation_result"."file_id" = "id" AND ("storage"."files"."uploaded_by_user_id" = $2::uuid OR "storage"."files"."bucket_id" = $3::text) LIMIT 1) SELECT row_to_json((SELECT "_e" FROM (SELECT "mutation_result.r.file.base"."id" AS "id", "mutation_result.r.file.base"."bucket_id" AS "bucketId") AS "_e")) AS "file" FROM "mutation_result.r.file.base") AS "mutation_result.r.file" ON ('true') LEFT OUTER JOIN LATERAL (WITH "mutation_result.r.department.base" AS (SELECT * FROM "public"."departments" WHERE "mutation_result"."department_id" = "id" AND "public"."departments"."id" = ANY($4::uuid[]) LIMIT 1) SELECT row_to_json((SELECT "_e" FROM (SELECT "mutation_result.r.department.base"."name" AS "name") AS "_e")) AS "department" FROM "mutation_result.r.department.base") AS "mutation_result.r.department" ON ('true')
